title: T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application
content: Adversaries may exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program to gain initial access to a network. The weakness may be a software bug, temporary glitch, or misconfiguration.

title: T1046 - Network Service Discovery
content: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices, including by scanning ports.

title: T1110 - Brute Force
content: Adversaries may use brute-force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or password hashes are obtained.

title: T1059 - Command and Scripting Interpreter
content: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

title: T1071.001 - Web Protocols
content: Adversaries may communicate using application-layer web protocols to avoid detection by blending with existing traffic.

title: CVE-2021-44228 - NVD snapshot
content: Apache Log4j2 message lookup substitution could allow attacker-controlled JNDI endpoints to cause remote code execution in affected log4j-core versions. NVD assigns CVSS 3.1 base score 10.0.

title: CVE-2024-3094 - NVD snapshot
content: Malicious code found in XZ Utils versions 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 could interfere with sshd authentication through liblzma in affected environments.
